description: Monoecious acaulescent herb, 8–20 cm tall. *Stems* tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−10 mm diam. *Leaves* unifoliate, basifixed; petiole dark red, brown when dry, 3−10 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, light bright green or dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green or vinaceous or dark red; deltate or cordate, 2−15 by 2−10 cm, base truncate, apex acute, margin crenate or sinuate, venation palmate, veins 4−7, inconspicuous on both sides. *Stipules* caducous, pale green, lanceolate, 2−3 by 1−2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* axillary between a pair of leafy bracts, dichasial, 2−3 times, bisexual, 4−16 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles c. 2.5−12 cm long, terete, glabrous, dark red on half way from base, then pale green, glossy. *Bracts* leafy, 1 pair, 1.5−4.5 by 1−2 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 8−12 mm, ascending, tepals 4, plain white, obovate or oblanceolate, 5−6 by 2−3 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium zygomorphic, stamens 10−11, bright yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 2 mm long, anthers oblong, 1−1.5 mm long, dehiscing by short pores near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 4−6 mm long, tepals 4(−5), plain white or pale pink, glabrous on both side, subequal, outer 3 obovate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, inner 1 oblanceolate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; styles 3, fused at base, bright yellow, stigmatic band kidney-shaped, minutely papillose; ovary pale green, 3-locular, with 3 subequal wings, placentae unilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green, pendulous, drying pale brown, 5 by 6−7 mm with wings; locules ovate, 3−4 by 3−4 mm, abaxial wing narrowly oblong, once twisted, 4−5 mm long, c. 2 mm at base, 2 lateral wings orbicular, 4−5 mm long, 4−5 mm wide at base. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, ellipsoidal or oblong, mean size 250 by 137 μm; collar cells elongated, 4/5 of seed length, testa cells polygonal with straight anticlinal walls of testa cells; antical walls of testa cells thin and raised; operculum c. 50 – 70 μm long, short, nipple-shaped; cuticular pattern consisting mainly of smooth ornamention.

description: Notes.— The noticeably elongated leaf tips of this species produce plantlets. Herbarium specimens of *B. elisabethae* and *B. vagans* may look similar in this respect, however, the fruits differ as they are in different sections of the genus: *B. vagans* has 3-locular fruit with three equal wings, whilst *B. elisabethae* has 2-locular fruit with one enlarged wing. Moreover, the inflorescence of *B. elisabethae* is a compound cyme, whilst in *B. vagans* it is a raceme of cymes.

description: Monoecious caulescent herb, 10−20 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, suberect, glabrous or strigose, pale green or dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−10 mm diam. *Leaves* only 2(−3) per plant, basifixed; peduncles, terete, 5−6 cm long, pale green, glossy, glabrous. *Bracts* caducous, boat-shaped, ovate, pale green with red striation, 1−1.5 by 1.5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Staminate flowers* pedicels 8−15 mm, erect, hairy, tepals 4, plain white or white with red striation, outer 2 obovate, 6−15 by 6−10 mm, base rounded, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous or dense uncinate hairs at middle, inner 2 ovate obovate, 5−12 by 2−6 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, androphore c. 3 mm long, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments 0.3−0.5 mm long, anthers ovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip, fused at base. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 4−7 mm long; tepals 5, subequal, obovate, 10−12 by 5−7 mm, white with red striation, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, inner surface glabrous, outer surface covered with uncinate hairs; ovary with 3 subequal wings, pale green with red striation, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate; styles 2, fused at base, 5−10 mm long, stigma yellow, spiral, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, stigma surface densely papillose. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green with red striation, pendulous, drying pale brown, 18−20 by 10−12 mm; locules ovate, 6−10 by 10−12 mm, abaxial wing nodding, obliquely deltate, c. 20 mm tall, lateral wings deltate, curved along length of capsule, 10 mm tall. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.4−0.5 mm long, collar cells c. 1/2 length of seed.

description: Monoecious caulescent herb c. 20 cm tall. *Stems *tuberous, globose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−5 mm diam., aerial stem pale green, glabrous, brown when dry, 4−12 cm long. *Leaves* sessile, 1–2 per plant, lamina basifixed, alternate; leaf blade succulent, chartaceous when dry, symmetric, adaxial glabrous, light bright green or dull greenish yellow, glossy, abaxial pale green, orbicular or suborbicular, 4−15 by 5−16 cm, base cordate, margin crenate, venation palmate, veins 4−7, prominent beneath. *Stipules* not seen. *Inflorescences* terminal, paniculate, 1–3 times, bisexual, 20−30 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous, peduncles 10−18 cm long, terete, densely covered with multicellular glandular hairs, pale green, glossy. *Bracts* leafy, orbicular. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale green or pale pink, 10−15 mm long, densely hairy, erect, tepals 2, white near centre and pale pink surrounded an outline, outer parts bright pink; orbicular, 4−5 by 5−6 mm, base slightly rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts densely hairy, inner parts glabrous, androecium zygomorphic, stamens 10, bright yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 7−10 mm long, densely hairy, tepals 2(–3), same colour as staminate flower, orbicular, 6−7 by 6−7 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts densely hairy, inner parts glabrous, styles 3, fused at base, dark yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, minutely papillose; ovary green or pink with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular; placentae unilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, c. 10–15 by 4−5 mm; locules ovate, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, abaxial wing deltoid, c. 10 mm long, 5−6 mm at base, 2 lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, c. 3 mm long, 5−6 mm wide at base. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious caulescent herb 30–40 cm tall. *Stems *rhizomatous with numerous fibrous roots, 15−18 mm diam, aerial stem terete, succulent. *Leaves* 1–2 per plant, lamina basifixed; petiole glabrous, brown when dry, 4−12 cm long; leaf blade succulent, chartaceous when dry, symmetric or asymmetric, adaxial and abaxial surfaces glabrous, palmatipartite, 18−32 by 6.5−11 cm, base cordate, leaf deeply incised, sinus deep with biserrate margin, venation palmate, veins 5−7, prominent beneath. *Stipules* not seen. *Inflorescences* arising from rhizome and terminal, dichasium, 1–2 times, bisexual, 10−30 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous, peduncles 7−25 cm long, terete, glabrous. *Bracts* caducous, ovate, 10−12 by 6−7 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels c. 10−15 mm long, glabrous, tepals 4, outer 2 obovate, 4−6 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblanceolate, 4−5 by 2−3 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers oblong c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels 10−15 mm long, tepals 5; obovate, 6−7 by 3−4 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, forked once, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, spiral, minutely papillose; ovary narrowly oblong with 3 equal narrow wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, 15–20 by 5−7 mm; locules elongate-oblong, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, wings deltoid and narrowly curved along length of capsule, c. 3 mm tall. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious acaulescent herb, 4–7 cm tall. *Stems* succulent, erect, dark red, terete, tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−5 mm diam. *Leaves* 3–5, arising from tuber or basal of short aerial stem, lamina basifixed; petiole dark red basal, pale green above, brown when dry, 0.5−3 cm long, leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface echinate, dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green or dark red on veins, ovate to oval, 5−20 by 5−10 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded and deeply sinuate, margin sinuate on half way of leaf blade, venation palmate, veins 4−5, prominent beneath. *Stipules* persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 1−2 by 0.5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, cyme, 1−2 times, bisexual, 4−7 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous, peduncles c. 3 cm long, terete, glabrous, dark red in basal half, then pale green, glossy. *Bracts* 1 pair, 3 by 1 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 3−5 mm, ascending, tepals 4, pale magenta, outer 2 orbicular, 3−4 by 2−3 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts sparsely echinate at middle, inside glabrous, inner 2 obcordate or obdeltate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 10, bright yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by short slits near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 4−6 mm long, tepals 5 (−7), pale magenta, sparsely echinate outside, subequal, outer 3 obovate, 3−5 by 1−2 mm, inner 3 oblanceolate or obdeltate, 3−5 by 2 mm, styles 3, fused at base, bright yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, minutely papillose, ovary pale green, 3-locular, with 3 subequal wings, placentae unilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, glossy, pale green, drying pale brown, 5−6 by 6−7 mm with wings, locules ovate, 3−4 by 3−4 mm, abaxial wing irregular trigonous and curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long, c. 10 mm at base, 2 lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, c. 3 mm tall 4−5 mm at base. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious acaulescent herb, 20−100 cm tall. *Stems *rhizomatous, rhizome elongate, creeping, 1–3 times branching, glossy, dark red, 15−20 mm diam., with numerous fibrous roots. *Leaves*: petiole dark red, 20−90 cm long, lamina basifixed, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, dull dark green, abaxial surface sparsely hairy on veins, pale green, glossy; ovate, 14−25 by 7−30 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate, margin sinuate and ciliate or with 3 arching tip at the end of veins, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 7−9 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath.* Stipules* persistent, dark red, ovate, c. 5 by 10 mm, apex acute, margin ciliate. *Inflorescences* arising from rhizome, bisexual, 40−100 cm long, polychasium, branching 1–2 times with many staminate flowers and c. 14–16 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous, peduncle terete, densely hirsute, dark red, glossy, 25−70 cm long. *Bracts* caducous, leafy, ovate, apex obtuse, margin ciliate, pale green, glossy. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 10 mm long, tepals 4, pale pink, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10 by 9 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin slightly crenate, outer parts hairy with glandular hairs, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 oblong, 10 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or truncate, margin entire, outer parts hairy with glandular hairs, inner parts glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments nearly free, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong, 1−1.5 mm long, dehiscing vertical by slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 10−20 mm long, tepals 4, pale pink, outer 2 orbicular, 10−12 by 10−12 mm, covered with glandular hairs on outer parts, inner 2 obovate, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, covered with glandular hairs on outer parts, styles 3, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary very hairy with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, very hairy with glandular hairs when young, glabrous when mature, drying pale brown, 20−25 by 10−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 10 by 7 mm, abaxial wing triangular or crest-shaped, c. 10 mm long, c. 10 mm wide at base, 2 laterals narrower, crest−shaped curved along length capsule, 2−3 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Notes.— *Begonia integrifolia* Dalzell is probably the most common species in Thailand, found from low elevations to high montane areas. The species is very variable in flower colour and leaf colour patterns. It is related to* B. variabilis* Ridl., which differs in having a more elongated leaf lamina with a very large basal lobe, also the seed ornamentation of the two species differs. *Begonia socia *Craib *and B. rimarum *Craib are treated as synonyms here because they show no significant morphological differences from *B. integrifolia*.

description: Monoecious caulescent herb, 30 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, glabrous or sparsely or densely hairy, pale green or dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−13 mm diam. *Leaves* only 2−3(−5) per plant, basifixed, asymmetric, petiole pale green or dark red, reddish brown when dry, 4−20 cm long, leaf blade succulent, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely or densely hairy, dull light green or brown to black with silver spots or mid green with white spots or reddish brown with silver spots, glossy, iridescent, abaxial sparsely or densely hairy, pale green or vinaceous or dark red, ovate, 7−25 by 4−15 cm, base cordate, apex acute or rounded, margin entire with sparse hair or slightly undulate, venation palmate-pinnate, veins 4−8 pairs, midrib prominent beneath. *Stipules* persistent, greenish white or pale green or dark red with red striation, lanceolate, glabrous or hairy outside, apex acute, margin entire, 5−14 by 2−8 mm. *Inflorescences* terminal, dichasium, bisexual, branched 1−4 times, 7−15 (−17) cm long, with 4−9 staminate flowers and 2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous, peduncles, c. 3−13 cm long, terete, pale green or dark red, glossy, glabrous. *Bracts* persistent, membranous, ovate, 10−15 by 4−5 mm, dark red, pale green or whitish pink, glossy, apex obtuse, margin entire. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels 5−15 mm, erect (or occasionally ascending), tepals 4, plain white or white with red striation, outer 2 orbicular, 5−13 by 5−10 mm, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; inner 2 ovate-lanceolate, 5−8 by 2−3 mm, base rounded, apex acute, margin entire, base cuneate, glabrous on both side, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments, fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 5−7 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, 4 ovate-oblong, 8−10 by 2−5 mm, 1 oval, 2−5 by 1−2 mm, white or white with red striation or pale pink, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, once spirally twisted, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 subequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green or pale green with red striation, pendulous, drying pale brown, 10−20 by 11−15 mm; locules ovate, 7−15 by 5−7 mm, abaxial wing orbicular-triangular, 10−15 mm long, lateral wings narrower, deltate, curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.4−0.5 mm long, collar cells c. 1/2 length of seed.

description: Monoecious rhizomatous herb. *Rhizome* elongate, creeping, glabrous, c. 30 cm long, c. 4−5 mm diam. *Leaves*: petiole glabrous, c. 10 cm long, lamina peltate, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dried, glabrous on both sides, ovate to oval, 8−10 by 8−10 cm, base obliquely rounded, apex caudate, margin entire or somewhat sparsely caudate 2−3 near the apex, venation palmate, 7−9 lateral veins branching, slightly impressed above and prominent beneath.* Stipules* persistent, ovate, 4−5 by 3−4 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* arising from rhizome, bisexual, ca. 15 cm long, polychasial, branching 1–2 times, protandrous; peduncle terete, 10−12 cm long. *Bracts* persistent, membranous, ovate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, glabrous, apex obtuse, margin entire. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels 8−10 mm long, tepals 4, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, reddish, 4−5 by 4−6 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous, inner 2 oblanceolate, 15 by 3 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels 5−10 mm long, tepals 4, unequal, glabrous, outer 2 dark red, ovate, ca. 4−5 by 5−6 mm, inner 2, white, oblanceolate, 5 by 2 mm, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, once spirally twisted, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placenta one per locule. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, nodding, pendulous, drying pale brown, 20 by 10 mm, locules ovate, 15 by 5−6 mm, abaxial wing curve with rounded tip, 20 mm wide and 10 mm tall, lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, 3−4 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 5–20 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, glabrous or sparsely or densely hairy, pale green or dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−10 mm diam. *Leaves* 1−2(−4) per plant, basifixed; petiole pale green or dark red, reddish brown when dry, 2−10 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric or subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely or densely hairy, dull light or dark green or brown to black or mid green, glossy, iridescent, abaxial sparsely hairy on veins, pale green or dark red on veins; ovate, 3−25 by 4−15 cm, base cordate, apex acute, margin entire or sinuate or deeply sinuate with sparse hairs, venation palmate, veins 6−7. *Stipules* caducous, pale green, lanceolate, glabrous, apex acute, margin entire, 3−4 by 2−3 mm. *Inflorescences* terminal, 3−15 cm long, dichasial, bisexual, 1−4 times branched with many staminate flowers and 1–2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncles 2−10 cm long, terete, pale green or dark red, glossy, glabrous. *Bracts* persistent, membranous, pale green, glossy, ovate-lanceolate, 3−4 by 1−2 mm, apex obtuse, margin entire. *Staminate flowers* pedicels 5−10 mm, erect (or occasionally ascending), tepals 4, pinkish white or pale pink, outer 2 orbicular, 3−6 by 4−5 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 3−4 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obcordate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip, filaments fused at base. *Pistillate flowers* pedicels pale pink, 3−10 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, 4 ovate oblong, pale pink, 4−7 by 2−5 mm, 1 ovate, 2−5 by 1−2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 subequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green, pendulous, drying pale brown, c. 8−15 by 5−10 mm, locules elliptic, 3−8 by 3−6 mm, abaxial wing oblong−triangular and sinuate, 10−18 mm long, lateral wings narrower, slightly deltate, curved along length of capsule, 3−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Notes.— This endemic species is restricted to limestone and is distributed along the limestone outcrops that begin in the north, then through Kanchanaburi, and into the South-western and Peninsular regions. description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10–25 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, densely hairy, dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 4−10 mm diam. *Leaves* only 2−4(−5) per plant, lamina basifixed; petiole dark red, densely pilose, reddish brown when dry, 1.5−10(−15) cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric or subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface densely pilose, dull light or dark green or dull dark green with black or reddish brown variegated patches on veins, abaxial surface densely pilose, pale green or dark red on veins, ovate or orbicular, 2−11 by 3−10 cm, base cordate, apex rounded, margin crenate, ciliate, venation palmate, veins 5−7. *Stipules* persistent, dark red, lanceolate, 2−3 by 0.5−1 mm, hairy, apex acute, margin ciliate. *Inflorescences* terminal, cymose, bisexual, branched 1−2 times, 3−6 cm long, with 3−4 staminate flowers and 1 pistillate flower per branch, protandrous; peduncles terete, 3−6 cm long, whitish pink, glossy, densely pilose. *Bracts* caducous, membranous, lanceolate, 2−3 by 1 mm, pale green, densely pilose, apex obtuse, margin entire. *Staminate flowers* pedicels erect, whitish pink, 10−30 mm, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 orbicular or obovate, 10−12 by 8−10 mm, base obtuse or cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts densely pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner tepals absent or 2 narrowly oblong, 4−5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, subglobose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments c. 1 mm long, fused at base; anthers obovate c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels greenish white, 10−20 mm long, tepals 2, plain white, ovate or orbicular, 8−10 by 9−10 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer part densely pilose, styles 3, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, dark yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary green with red striation, 3 subequal wings, densely pilose, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, pale green with red striation, drying pale brown, 10−12 by 10 mm, locules elliptic, 3 by 8 mm, wings 3, subequal, triangular, c. 5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.4 mm.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 30−100 cm tall. *Stems *erect, dark red, terete; rhizome elongate, creeping, glossy, dark red, 10−15 mm in diam. with numerous fibrous roots. *Leaves* 3−6 per plant; petiole dark red, densely pilose, 20−30 cm long; lamina basifixed, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface with dense short hairs, dull dark green, abaxial surface with densely short hairs on veins, pale green or dark red on veins, glossy, palmatifid, 15−30 by 17−24 cm, apex acuminate in each lobed base margin deeply lobed, cordate or sagittate, 7−9 lobed, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 7−9 veins, slightly impressed above and prominent beneath.* Stipules* persistent, dark red, ovate-lanceolate, 10 by 5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* axillary, bisexual, 1–2 cm long, dichasial, branching 1–2 times with 8–10 staminate flowers and c. 2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle, terete, 0.5−1 cm long, glossy, dark red, densely pilose. *Bracts* caducous, ovate-lanceolate, apex acute, margin entire, dark red, glossy. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 10−40 mm long, densely pilose, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10−12 by 10 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts densely pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 oblovate, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or incised, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments free, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong c. 3 mm long, dehiscing by vertical slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, densely pilose, 15−20 mm long, tepals 6, white or tinged pale pink, ovate to orbicular, 3−5 by 5−6 mm, densely pilose outside, styles 4, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary dark red or brownish green, densely pilose, 4-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruits* a fleshy berry, densely pilose when young, glabrous when mature, drying dark brown, ovate, 20 by 15 mm *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Notes.— *Begonia procridifolia* differs from other species in section *Parvibegonia* in having 6(−8) leaves per plant, most species have fewer. Also, the largest wing on the mature fruit has a distinctive curved cucullate shape and the bracts are larger than those of any other species in the section. The epithet reflects the leaf shape, reminscent of *Procris* (Urticaceae).

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 20−60 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, erect, glabrous, dark red or pale pink with red striations; tubers subglobose, 15−20 mm diam, with numerous fibrous roots. *Leaves* all in the same horizontal plane, 6 −7 (−8) per plant; petiole pale red, 5−20 mm long; lamina basifixed, succulent, strongly asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely scabrous, dull dark green, dark purplish black or dull green with white spots, iridescent, abaxial surface sparsely scabrous on veins, dark reddish, glossy; narrowly oblong-lanceolate and slightly falcate, 7−18 by 1.5−4 cm; base markedly asymmetric, one side cuneate, the other overlapping the petiole slightly apex elongate, margin serrate or slightly serrate, venation pinnate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 5−10 pairs of lateral veins branching per side, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath.* Stipules* persistent, pale green with dark red striations, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, 10−12 by 4−5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, bisexual, 3−6 cm long, dichasial, with a few minute verrucula, branched 1−2 times, with 4−6 staminate flowers and 2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle terete, 1.8−2.5 cm long, pale greenish-pink, scabrid, glossy. *Bracts* persistent, membranaceous, narrowly oblong, margin entire, apex obtuse or acute, pale green, glossy, 5−7 by 1 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale greenish-pink 5−7 mm long, with a few minute verrucula, tepals 4, pale pink or pinkish-white with dark pinkish striations, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 7−8 by 5−6 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both side, inner 2 oblanceolate, 6−7 by 3−4 mm, base cuneate, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both side, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 90−95, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers c. 1 mm long, obcordate, dehiscing by short pore-like slits near tip, filaments fused at base. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale greenish-pink, 5−6 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, 3 obovate, 2 orbicular, 7−8 by 5−7 mm, pale pink with dark pinkish striations, base obtuse in obovate and rounded in orbicular tepals, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, once spirally twisted, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped and compressed, seeming capitate, ovary with 3 subequal wings, 2-locular; placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, nodding and forming a splash-cup at maturity, glossy, pale greenish-pink with dark red striations, drying pale brown, 15 by 14−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 8−10 by 4−5 mm, adaxial wing obliquely crest-shaped with rounded apex, 10−12 mm long, lateral wings deltoid, curved along length of capsule, 7−8 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, ellipsoidal, 0.4−0.5 mm long, collar cells c. 3/4 length of seed.

description: Notes.— *Begonia prolifera* is known from a single small population in Kanchanaburi. Its vegetative characters resemble *B. fibrosa* in some aspects (see notes under *B. fibrosa* for diagnostic characters). It may be more widely distributed on limestone outcrops along the Tenasserim range, on both the Thai and Myanmar sides. Lack of observations may be due to difficulty of accessing the friable limestone habitat of this species during the wet season, and during the dry season it dies back to a small tuber.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5−10 cm tall. *Stems*: tuber globose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−5 mm diam., aerial stem dark red, glabrous, brown when dry, 4−8 cm long. *Leaves* unifoliate, sessile, lamina basifixed; leaf blade succulent, chartaceous, symmetric or subsymmetric, adaxial surface sparsely echinate, light bright green or pale green, glossy, abaxial pale green; orbicular in cordate shaped, 4−10 by 5−10 cm, base cordate, apex rounded, margin entire or slightly crenate, venation palmate, veins 9−10, prominent beneath. *Stipules* not seen. *Inflorescences* terminal, dichasial, 1–2 times, bisexual, 8−10 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete 7−8 cm long, glabrous, dark red. *Bracts* not seen. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels greenish white, 5−10 mm long, glabrous, tepals 4, pinkish white, outer 2 orbicular, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 4−5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens c. 12, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obcordate or obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip, filaments fused at base. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 4−10 mm long, tepals 5, pale pink, unequal, 4 ovate to oblong, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, 1 obovate, 4 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, glossy, pale green, drying pale brown, 8−12 by 8−10 mm, locules elliptic, 7 by 8−10 mm, abaxial wing obliquely ligulate c. 10 mm long, lateral wings narrower, cucullate, c.1/3 of capsule length, 3−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 12−25 cm tall, whole plant covered with glandular hairs.* Stems *succulent, glossy, suberect with 2−5 branches, dark red at base, turning pale green near top; tubers irregularly heart-shaped with numerous fibrous roots, 5−13 mm diam. *Leaves* all in the same horizontal plane, alternate, 8−30 per plant, basifixed; petioles pale red, with an adaxial groove, 1.5−3 mm long, leaf blade membranaceous, subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface with dense glandular hairs, light green, glossy, iridescent, abaxial surface with dense glandular hairs, pale greenish white with red hyaline line along margin, narrowly lanceolate, 2−8 by 0.5−1 cm, base symmetric or subsymmetric, truncate or subcordate, apex caudate or more acuminate, margin dentate, midrib prominent beneath, hairy; lateral veins 7–8 on each side. *Stipules* persistent, pale green, triangular or ovate-triangular with sparse minute glandular hairs, c.1 by 1 mm, apex acuminate, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal or at least near the apex, dichasial, bisexual, 1−3 branches, 0.5−2.5 cm long with 2−4 staminate flowers and 2 pistillate flowers per branch; protandrous; peduncle, 0.5−1 cm long, terete, pale green, glossy, hairy. *Bracts* deciduous, membranous, ovate-triangular, oblong, 1−2 by 0.5−1 mm, apex acute, white, pale green, glossy, margin sparsely ciliate. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels 5−6 mm, sparsely hairy, tepals 4, plain white, outer 2 ovate or obovate, 2 by 2−3 mm, base cuneate, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; inner 2 oblanceolate, 2 by 1 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium zygomorphic; stamens 10−12, yellow, filaments fused at base c.0.5 mm long, anthers cordate, c.1 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels white, sparsely hairy, 5−6 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, oblanceolate or obovate, plain white, 2−3 by 1−2 mm, base cuneate, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band kidney-shaped, papillose, ovary with 3 unequal wings, plain white, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, pendulous, creamy white, turning brown when dry, 15 by 10−12 mm, locules oblong, 4 by 1.5−2 mm, abaxial wing obliquely triangular, c. 3 mm long, lateral wings narrower, triangular, 1−2 mm long, c.1/3 capsule length. *Seeds* numerous, brown, ellipsoid.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, c. 5 cm tall. *Stems *erect, glabrous; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 2−5 mm in diam. *Leaves* 2−4(−5) per plant, basifixed; petiole, 1−3 cm long; leaf blade membranaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, palmatifid, 1−2.5 by 1.5−2 cm, base cordate, apex of each lobe acute, margin sinuate or deeply sinuate with 4−7 lobes, venation palmate, veins 4−5. *Stipules* persistent, lanceolate, 2 by 1 mm, glabrous, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, simple cymes, bisexual, 3−4 cm long; peduncles terete, 10−15 mm long, glabrous. *Bracts* persistent, membranaceous, lanceolate, c. 1 mm long, apex acute, margin entire. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels 2−3 mm, tepals 4, pale pink, outer 2 ovate, 4−5 by 4 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides; inner 2 oblong, 3−4 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens c.20, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, anthers obcordate c. 0.5 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip, filaments fused at base. *Pistillate flowers*: not seen. *Fruits*: 2-locular capsules , pendulous, drying pale brown, c. 5 by 5 mm, locules elliptic, 2−3 by 3 mm, abaxial wing orbicular with wavy curved on wing, 10−18 mm long, lateral wings narrower, shortly triangular, curved along length of capsule, 5 mm long. *Seeds* unknown.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10–15 cm tall. *Stems *erect, terete, dark red, tuber globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 10 mm diam. *Leaves* 1–2 per plant, lamina dorsifixed; petiole dark red 2−5 cm long; leaf blade membranaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, adaxial surface dull dark green or light bright green, abaxial surface pale green, peltate, 3 by 7 cm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin crenate or undulate, venation palmate, veins 7−8, prominent beneath. *Stipules* caducous, narrowly lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. *Inflorescences* terminal, paniculate, bisexual, 8−15 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete, c. 6−8 cm long, dark red, densely glandular hairy. *Bracts* persistent, lanceolate, c. 2 by 1 mm; *bracteoles* 1 pair, opposite, lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels densely glandular hairy, c. 10 mm, tepals 4, white, outer 2 ovate, 5 by 4 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 linear oblanceolate, c. 3 by 1 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, elliptic, stamens 8−10, filaments fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, thecae wing-like, dehiscing by vertical slit. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels, c. 10 mm long, pale green, densely glandular hairy, tepals 3, plain white, outer 2 ovate, c. 5 by 4 mm, glabrous on both sides, inner 1 oblanceolate, c. 3 by 1 mm, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae unilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, 8−10 by 10−13 mm with wings, locules ovate, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, abaxial triangular, c. 10 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrowly triangular, 4 mm curved along length of capsule. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5–15 cm tall. *Stems *tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 5–10 mm diam. *Leaves* unifoliate; petiole densely pilose, 4−10 cm long; leaf blade basifixed, subcoriaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, 6.5 by 6 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate, margin crenate or serrate, venation palmate, veins 5−7, prominent beneath. *Stipules* caducous, narrowly lanceolate, c. 2 mm long. *Inflorescences* arising from tuber, dichasial, bisexual, 5−10 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete, 4−8 cm long, densely pilose. *Bracts* persistent, lanceolate, c. 2 by 1 mm; *bracteoles* 1 pair, opposite, lanceolate, c. 2 by 1 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels densely pilose, c. 4−10 mm, tepals 4, pink, outer 2, ovate, c. 6 by 5 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, outer parts densely pilose, inner parts glabrous, inner 2 linear oblanceolate, c. 5 by 2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 0.5 mm long, anthers oblong, c. 1 mm long, thecae thin, wing-like, dehiscing by vertical slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels c. 10 mm long, densely pilose, tepals 4, pink, outer 2 ovate, 5−6 by 4 mm, densely pilose outside, inner 2 oblanceolate, c. 4 by 2, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary dark red with 3 unequal wings, densely pilose, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, dark red, drying pale brown, 15−20 by 18−20 mm with wings, locules oblong, c.20 by 6−10 mm, abaxial triangular shaped, 15−20 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, narrowly triangular, 8 mm long, *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, c. 45 cm tall. *Stem*:* *base rhizomatous with numerous fibrous roots, creeping, 5−15 mm diam., aerial stem succulent, erect, terete with distinct swollen nodes. *Stipules* persistent, ovate-lanceolate, 12 by 5 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Leaves* horizontal, alternate, basifixed; petiole, 6−10 cm long, lamina succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, glabrous on both sides, ovate-oblong, 8−15 by 4−8 cm, base asymmetric, truncate, apex attenuate, margin incised or remotely serrate, venation palmate-pinnate, veins 6−7, midrib prominent beneath. *Inflorescences* axillary, bisexual, c. 15 cm long, dichasial, 1−2 branched; peduncle terete 4−7 cm long, glabrous. *Bracts* caducous, membranous, oblong-lanceolate; apex acute, margin entire, 5−7 by 1.5−3 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels 5−10 mm, erect, glabrous, tepals 4, outer 2 ovate, 5−6 by 3−4 mm, base cuneate, rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 4−5 by 2−3 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments free, c. 1.5 mm long, anthers reniform, c. 0.7 mm long, dehiscing by longitudinal slits near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels 5−10 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, glabrous, largest ovate c. 5 by 2 mm, smallest oblanceolate, 5−6 by 2 mm, styles 2, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, once spirally twisted, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent rain-splash capsule, pendulous, drying pale brown, 30–35 by 10 mm, locules ovate, 15 by 5−6 mm, abaxial wing ligulate with rounded tip, 20−25 mm long, lateral wings narrower, curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5−8 cm tall. *Stems *tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−8 mm diam. *Leaves* 1 (–2) per plant, basifixed; petiole pale green or sometimes dark red, brown when dry, 4−5 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface glabrous, light green or dull reddish brown, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green or vinaceous, palmatifid, 4−10 by 7−11 cm, leaf incision parted, base subcordate, apex acuminate, margin minutely double serrate, venation palmate, veins 6−8, prominent beneath. *Stipules* persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 1−3 by 1−2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* arising from tuber, dichasial, bisexual, 8−12 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 20–90 cm tall. *Stem *erect, succulent, terete, dark red, rhizome elongate with numerous fibrous roots, brownish yellow, sparsely brown pubescent, 20–25 mm diam. *Leaves* 3–7 per plant; ovate, 10−18 by 7−20 cm, base obliquely cordate, apex acuminate, margin entire or slightly serrate, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 5−10 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath.* Stipules* caducous, dark brown, ovate, 4−5 by 10 mm, apex acuminate, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, bisexual, 10−20 cm long, dichasial or polychasial, branching 1–2 times with 3–10 staminate flowers and 2–6 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle terete 7−15 cm long, dark red with dense, brown pubescent hairs. *Bracts* caducous, dark red, ovate, brown villous, 0.5−15 by 4−10 mm, apex acute, margin ciliate. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale green, brown villous, 10−20 mm long, tepals 4, white or pale pink, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10−15 by 10−12 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 7−12 by 5−10 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse or rounded, margin entire, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 2 mm long, anthers oblong or obovate, c. 2 mm long, dehiscing vertical by slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, sparsely pubescent, c. 10−20 mm long, tepals 6, white or pale pink, unequal, outer 3 ovate to orbicular, c. 20 by 10 mm, glabrous on both sides, inner 3 obovate, 13−15 by 8−10 mm, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped and spiral, ovary dark red or pale pink, densely brown tomentose, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, dark red or pale green with sparse hairs, drying pale brown, 18−20 by 20 mm, locules oblong, c.12 by 10 mm, abaxial wing obliquely orbicular or ligulate, c. 15 mm long, 2 laterals narrower, rectangular, curved along length of capsule, 4−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 5–10 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, erect or suberect, densely stellate hairy, dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5−10 mm in diam. *Leaves* only 1−2 per plant, basifixed; petiole dark red, reddish brown when dry, 2−4 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely stellate hairy, dull light green or dark green, glossy, iridescent, abaxial surface pale green or vinaceous, densely stellate hairy especially on veins, 3−17 by 3−13 cm, base cordate, apex acute, margin serrate or sinuate or remotely sinuate with stellate hairs, venation palmate, veins 6−8. *Stipules* caducous, dark red, ovate-lanceolate, 4−5 by 2−3 mm long, densely stellate hairy, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, dichasial, bisexual, branched 1−2 times, 4−17 cm long, with many staminate flowers and 1–2 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncles terete, 3−14 cm long, pale green or dark red, glossy, glabrous. *Bracts* persistent, membranous, light pink, glossy, ovate-lanceolate, 2−5 by 2 mm, densely hairy, apex obtuse, margin entire. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels 3−10 mm, erect (or occasionally ascending), tepals 4, white or pale pink, outer 2 orbicular, 4−7 by 4−7 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 4−7 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments c. 0.5 mm long, fused at base, anthers obcordate or obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits near tip. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 4−10 mm long, tepals 5, unequal, white or pale pink, 3 ovate oblong, 4−7 by 4−7 mm, 2 obovate, 2−5 by 1−2 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 2, fused at base, yellow, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 2-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, glossy, pale green, pendulous, drying pale brown, 8−15 by 5−10 mm, locules elliptic, 10−25 by 8−10 mm, abaxial wing concave with wavy curved on wing, 10−18 mm long, lateral wings narrower, slightly triangular, curved along length of capsule, 3−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped, 0.3−0.5 mm long.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 15–70 cm tall. *Stems *erect, dark red, terete, very densely dark red pilose, rhizome with numerous fibrous roots, brownish yellow, elongate, very densely dark red pilose, 10–15 mm in diam. *Leaves* 3–7 per plant, lamina basifixed; petiole 4−25 cm long, very densely dark red pilose; leaf blade subcoriaceous, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface densely pilose hairs, dull dark green or dull dark grey green, abaxial surface very densely dark red pilose, glossy, ovate, 7−22 by 7−12 cm, base obliquely cordate, apex acuminate, margin ciliate, venation palmate, midrib and lateral veins concolourous with lamina, 7−8 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath.* Stipules* persistent, dark red, ovate, 10 by 12 mm, densely dark red pilose, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, bisexual, 10−30 cm long, dichasial or polychasial, branching 1–2 times with 3–7 staminate flowers and 2–4 pistillate flowers per branch, protandrous; peduncle, 10−22 cm long, terete, sparsely dark red pilose. *Bracts* caducous, ovate, densely dark red pilose, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, apex acute, margin ciliate. *Staminate flowers* pedicels greenish white, sparsely dark red pilose, 15−20 mm long, tepals 4, orange-red, outer 2 ovate to rhomboid, 10−15 by 8−15 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, outer parts densely dark red tomentose, inner 2 rhomboid or obovate, 8−10 by 7−8 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments fused at base, c. 2 mm long, anthers oblong or obovate, c. 2 mm long, dehiscing by vertical slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels greenish white, sparsely dark red tomentose, 15−20 mm long, tepals 5, orange-red, unequal, outer 4 ovate, 10−12 by 6−8 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides or sparsely dark red tomentose outside, inner 1 oblong, 10 by 8 mm, base obtuse, apex acute, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary orange-red, glabrous, ovary with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, pale green to orange-red, drying pale brown, 20−30 by 20 mm, capsules oblong, 5 by 15 mm, abaxial wing triangular, c. 20 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, triangular, curved along length capsule, 4−5 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 5–20 cm tall. *Stems* tuberous, globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 5 mm diam. *Leaves* unifoliate, lamina dorsifixed; petiole dark red, glabrous, 4−20 cm long; leaf blade subcoriaceous, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface dull dark green or dark grey green, strigose, abaxial surface pale green, densely strigose, 2−9 by 4−11 cm, base cordate and overlapping, apex rounded, margin serrate, ciliate, venation palmate, veins 7−12, prominent beneath. *Stipules* not seen. *Inflorescences* arising from tuber, cymose, bisexual, 10−13 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles terete, 10−11 cm long, dark red or pale green, glabrous. *Bracts* persistent, cuneiform with fimbriate apex, 4 by 2 mm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels glabrous, sparsely hairy, 10−15 mm, tepals 4, pink or pinkish white, outer dark pink, outer 2, obovate, 10 by 11 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin entire, outer parts densely hairy at middle, inside glabrous, inner 2 narrowly oblong, 5−7 by 2−3 mm, base obtuse, apex obtuse, margin entire, glabrous on both sides, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, filaments fused at base, c. 1 mm long, anthers obovate, c. 1 mm long, dehiscing by slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels 10−15 mm long, pale pink, glabrous, tepals 2−3(−4), pink or pinkish white, outsides dark red, outer 2 orbicular, c. 8 by 9 mm, glabrous on both sides, inner 1(−2), oblong, c. 8 by 1−2, glabrous on both sides, styles 3, fused at base, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary with 3 unequal wings, sparsely pubescent, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, drying pale brown, 10 by 15 mm with wings, locules oblong, 4−5 by 4−5 mm, abaxial triangular, c. 10 mm long, 2 lateral wings narrower, triangular, 4 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, ca 60 cm tall. *Stems *rhizomatous, rhizome elongate, creeping, 15−20 mm diam, with numerous fibrous roots. *Leaves*: petiole reddish brown when dry, 20−90 cm long, lamina basifixed, succulent, asymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface sparsely pubescent, dull dark green, abaxial surface sparsely hairy on veins, ovate, 14−20 by 10−20 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate, margin dentate-ciliate, venation palmate, 9−10 veins, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath.* Stipules* caducous, ovate, c. 5 by 7 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, bisexual, 50−60 cm long, polychasial, branching 1–2 times with many staminate flowers, protandrous; peduncle terete, densely pilose, dark red, 25−60 cm long. *Bracts* caducous, leafy, ovate, apex obtuse, margin ciliate, pale green, glossy. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 10 mm long, tepals 4, deep pink, outer 2 ovate to orbicular, 10 by 9 mm, base rounded, apex rounded, margin slightly crenate, glabrous on both sides, inner 2 oblong, 10 by 4−5 mm, base cuneate, apex obtuse or truncate, margin entire, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens numerous, yellow, filaments nearly free, c. 3 mm long, anthers oblong, 1−1.5 mm long, dehiscing vertical by slits. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicels pale pink, 10−20 mm long, tepals 3, deep pink, outer 2 orbicular, 10 by 11 mm, glabrous, inner 1 obovate, 10 by 8 mm, styles 3, fused at base, twice spirally twisted, stigmatic band crescent-shaped, ovary glabrous with 3 unequal wings, 3-locular, placentae bilamellate. *Fruit* a dehiscent capsule, very hairy with glandular hairs when young, glabrous when mature, drying pale brown, 20−25 by 10−15 mm, locules ovate-oblong, 10 by 7 mm, abaxial wing triangular or crest-shaped, c. 10 mm long, c. 10 mm wide at base, 2 laterals narrower, crest-shaped, curved along length of capsule, 2−3 mm long. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10–15 cm tall. *Stems* erect, succulent, terete, dark red, glabrous, tuber globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 5–10 mm diam. *Leaves* 3–7 per plant, lamina basifixed; description: Monoecious, acaulescent herb, 8–10 cm tall. Tuber subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, 4−7 mm diam. *Leaves* unifoliate, basifixed; petiole pale green, brown when dry, sessile to 5 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface with scattered minute hairs, dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, pale green, suborbicular-cordate, 2−5 by 2−6 cm, base cordate, apex obtuse, margin crenate with minute hairs, venation palmate, veins 5−8, inconspicuous on both sides. *Stipules* caducous, pale green, lanceolate, 2−3 by 1−2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* axillary, subtended by a pair of leafy bracts, dichasial, branched 1−2 times, bisexual, 4−8 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; peduncles c. 2−5 cm long, terete, minutely pubescent, pale green, glossy. *Bracts* leafy, 1 pair, 1.5−4.5 by 1−2 cm. *Staminate flowers*: pedicels pale green, 5−7 mm, ascending, tepals 4, outer 2 obovate, obtuse at apex, up to 6 by 7 mm, plain white, outside with dense minute hairs, inner 2 obovate, 6–7 by 2–3 mm, glabrous, androecium actinomorphic, globose, stamens 8–10, filaments fused at base into a ca. 1 mm long column, the free parts to 1 mm long; anthers narrowly oblong, 1.5–2.0 by 1.5 mm, yellow, obtuse at apex, opening by two sublateral slits along whole length of anther. *Pistillate flowers*: pedicel ca. 5 mm long, tepals 4, shape, size, colour and indumentum similar to those of staminate flower, styles 3, free, crescent-shaped, 4–5 mm long, stigmatic surface papillose, ovary stellately triangular, with three narrowly conical horn-like projections, pale green, pubescent when young, ca. 8–10 by 2–3 mm, 3-locular, placentation free central, placentae 1 per locule. *Fruit *a dehiscent capsule, shaped as ovary, 9–10 by 3–4 mm, dehiscence by longitudinal slits on upper surface. *Seeds* numerous, brown, barrel-shaped.

description: Monoecious, caulescent herb, 10−20 cm tall. *Stems *succulent, glossy, erect to suberect, glabrous, dark red; tubers globose or subglobose with numerous fibrous roots, c. 5−10 mm diam. *Leaves* 2−5 per plant, basifixed, alternate; petiole dark red, brown when dry, 1−8 cm long; leaf blade succulent, symmetric or subsymmetric, chartaceous when dry, adaxial surface scabrous, dull dark green, glossy, abaxial surface glabrous, glaucous, lanceolate in cordate shaped or cordate, 10−11 by 4−5 cm, base cordate, apex acuminate or elongate-acuminate, margin irregularly crenate, venation palmate, veins 6−8, midrib and veins grooved on adaxial surface. *Stipules* persistent, pale green, lanceolate, 3−4 by 2 mm, apex acute, margin entire. *Inflorescences* terminal, paniculate, bisexual, 5−15 cm long, staminate flowers basal, pistillate flowers distal, protandrous; description: *Begonia egamii* D. Borah, Taram & M. Hughes has a very unusual combination of characters, making it hard to find a close ally for taxonomic comparison. It shares some characters with *B. tamdaoensis* C.I Peng such as having hispid hairs on the tepals and ovary and a zygomorphic androecium, but differs in having leaves rugulose above (vs. smooth), two stigmas (vs. three), and anthers retuse at the apex (vs. with an extended connective).

description: Creeping herb, 15 – 28 cm long, strigose; rhizome 5–10 × 1–1.5 cm, internodes very short at base, becoming a creeping stem toward apex with internodes 1–4 cm long, mixed with more congested internodes so leaves can appear crowded together, stipules triangular to elliptic-ovate, 1–1.6 × 0.8–1.2 cm, glabrous adaxially, pubescent abaxially, margin ciliate, apex shortly acuminate. Stem decumbent, 8–22 × 0.3–0.5 cm, rooting at nodes, indumentum strigose (trichomes c. 5 mm long), red. Leaves appearing clustered when internodes are close together, on 6–20 × 0.2–0.3 cm petioles; lamina elliptic-ovate, 8–30 × 6–18 cm, rugulose, apex acute to shortly acuminate, base cordate with lobes overlapping, margin subentire, crenate, or serrate, ciliate, densely strigose, veins palmate, 7–9. Inflorescence axillary, cymose; peduncles strigose, primary 7.3–20 cm long, secondary 1.3–7.5 cm long, tertiary 0.5–4.5 cm long; bracts lanceolate to elliptic-ovate, 0.5–1 × 0.3–0.6 cm, acute, entire, pubescent, with a pedicel 1–2 cm long. Staminate flower with 4 tepals; outer tepals 2, broadly ovate to orbicular, 1.3–2 × 1–1.5 cm, glabrous inside, pubescent outside, pink; inner tepals 2, ovate to elliptic ovate, 1–1.3 × 0.5–0.7 cm, glabrescent outside, glabrous inside, pinkish white; stamens 30–60, anthers basifixed, ellipticobovate, c. 2 mm long, connective retuse, filament c. 1.5 mm long, fused at base into a stout column; pedicel 2.5–4 cm long, strigose. Pistillate flower with 5 tepals, unequal, elliptic ovate to broadly ovate, 1–1.3 × 0.9–1.2 cm, strigose outside, glabrous inside, pink; pistil c. 2–3 mm long, styles 2, c. 1 mm long, persistent, stigma papillose, yellow, ovary 2-locular, placentae bifid; pedicel 1–2 cm long, strigose. Capsule 1.2–1.5 cm long, densely strigose, with 1 oblong central wing and 2 shorter obtuse lateral wings, central wing 1–2 × 0.8–1 cm, lateral wings 1–1.2 × 0.3–0.5 cm.

description: Begonia egamii is known only from the type locality in the EB Project Nature reserve area, Arunachal Pradesh, northeastern India. This reserve area is spread over 100 hectares dedicated to safeguard the native and threatened plant species of Arunachal Pradesh. It was found growing in two different habitat types: (1) gregariously in a recently cleared patch fully exposed to sunlight along with Dicranopteris linearis (Burm. f.) Underw., Pteridium aquilinum (L.) Kuhn, Pseudodissochaeta assamica (C.B. Clarke) Nayar, Dimetia scandens (Roxb.) R.J. Wang, Carex sp.; (2) on moist shady cliff faces in association with Henckelia adenocalyx (Chatterjee) D.J. Middleton & Mich. Möller, Begonia handelii Irmsch., Hydrocotyle himalaica P.K. Mukh., Rhynchotechum parviflorum Blume, Boeica fulva C.B. Clarke, Alpinia sp., along with mosses and liverworts.

description: Similar to B. circumlobata, B. jinyuensis and B. scitifolia in having deeply palmately lobed leaves. Begonia ziroensis differs from B. circumlobata and B. jinyuensis in having the main two leaf lobes sharing a main vein at the base (not all leaf lobes with a distinct main vein not shared with other lobes), and capsules covered with very dense short fleshy hairs (not glabrous). It differs from B. scitifolia in having the main two leaf lobes sharing a main vein at the base (not all leaf lobes with a distinct main vein not shared with other lobes), leaf lobes which are broader and deeply and broadly dentate (not dentate), and capsules which are covered with very dense short fleshy hairs (not minutely pilose).

description: Rhizomatous, monoecious herb, 10–20 cm high. Rhizome 7–10 mm wide, densely strigose, internodes 1–1.5 cm long. Stipules subulate, 6–10 mm × 4–5 mm, glabrescent, hairs prominent on mid veined, margin entire, apex aristate, arista up to 3 mm long. Leaves 15–20 × 14–18 cm; petiole 7–10 × c. 0.3 cm, densely pubescent, lamina deeply palmately lobed, narrowly ovate to suborbicular, basifixed, base cordate, 7–11 × 6–10 cm, slightly asymmetric, adaxially sparsely pubescent, abaxially pubescent along veins; venation palmate, with 4 or 5 main veins; lobes 5, sometimes with 2 smaller lobes at the base, main two lobes sharing a vein at the base, elongate-triangular, margin deeply and broadly dentate, the dentitions finely serrate; apices acute to acuminate. Inflorescence axillary, up to 4–7 flowered cyme; peduncle densely pubescent, branching 2–3 times, primary 23.5 cm, secondary 0.4–0.8 cm, tertiary 0.1–0.4 mm long; bracts subulate, 3–7mm×25 mm. Staminate flower: pedicel 1–1.5 cm long, pubescent; tepals 4, white to pink; outer tepals 2, ovate to obovate, 1.2–2×1–1.7 cm, sparsely pubescent outside, denser near base, margin entire; inner tepals 2, obovate or oblong, 1.2–1.8 × 0.7–1 cm, glabrous; 90–110 stamens, c. 2 mm long, filaments c. 1 mm long, unequal, fused at base into a short column; anther obovate, c. 1 mm long, connective retuse. Pistillate flower: pedicel 11.6 cm long, pubescent; tepals 5, unequal, elliptic-ovate, 1.8–2.3 × 1–2 cm, white to pale pink, pubescent outside, glabrous inside; pistil 5–6 mm long, styles 2, 2–4mm long, forked and twisted; ovary 1 cm × 0.8 cm, covered with very dense short fleshy hairs, 2-locular, placentae bifid. Capsule oblong-ellipsoid, 1–1.2 × 1.5–1.7 cm, with dense short hairs; central wings 0.9–1.2 × 0.5–0.8 mm, triangular to rounded-oblong; lateral wings c. 1 mm × 0.5–0.8 cm.

description: *Begonia merendonensis* Moonlight & D. L. Kelly differs from *B. assurgens *Irmsch. in its staminate flowers with four (vs. two) tepals and 25 to 30 (vs. 13 to 20) stamens and its pistillate flowers with three (vs. two) tepals, three (vs. two) styles, and villous (vs. glabrous to sparsely pilose) ovary and wings.Within its range, *Begonia merendonensis *is a highly distinctive species. The only two other members of Begonia sect. Gireoudia known from Cortés Department are *B. plebeja *Liebm. and *B. sericoneura *Liebm., which both have thickened rhizomes with short (< 5 mm long) internodes that contrast with the narrow, elongated (> 2 cm long) internodes of B. merendonensis. Other species known from Cortés Department can be easily distinguished because they do not root at the nodes.In the key to the *Begonia *species of Mesoamerica provided by Burt-Utley (2015), *B. merendonensis* keys out as *B. assurgens *at couplet 135 of key 6 (couplet 131 in the PDF version). Both species are recognized by their glabrous to sparsely pubescent, elongated rhizomes and transversely ovate leaves held on elongated (up to 32 cm long) petioles. Distinguishing these two species when sterile is difficult, but in flower they are distinguished with ease by the number of tepals on their staminate (four in *B. merendonensis*, two in *B. assurgens*) and pistillate (three in* B. merendonensis*, two in *B. assurgens*) flowers.

description: *Begonia merendonensis* is known from a single specimen collected within Parque Nacional El Cusuco, so the area of occupancy and extent of occurence are estimated as 4 km2 . Most closely related species of Begonia are narrow endemics, so it is likely that the species is endemic to the Sierra del Merendón and the national park. The type locality is within 250 m of areas illegally felled within the national park. Google Earth imagery (Google Earth Pro 2020, accessed January 2022) shows recent and ongoing agricultural encroachment on all flanks of the Sierra and national park. As such, we assess *B. merendonensis *as Critically Endangered [CR B1ab(iii)+ B2ab(iii)] under IUCN criteria (IUCN, 2022) but note that a full survey of the species’ known and potential range is required to fully understand its conservation status

description: *Begonia multiloba *Moonlight differs from *B. almedana *Burt-Utley & Utley in its leaves which have 5 to 9 narrowly acuminate lobes around the margin (vs. 3 to 5 lobes, the lobes broadly triangular) and conspicuously dentate, ciliate margins (vs. serrulate to denticulate, sparsely ciliate); its caducous, membranaceous, broadly ovate bracts (vs. persistent, chartaceous, and narrowly lanceolate); and its staminate flowers with 2 or 3 (vs. 4) tepals and ca. 25 (vs. 30 to 75) stamens.*Begonia multiloba* is the only species in Guatemala with elongate rhizomes and broadly ovate leaves. Two specimens of this species (*Ávila et al. 3288* and *Quezada 1767*) were previously identified as *B. crassicaulis *Lindl, which is also a species with multilobed leaves from which *B. multiloba *is easily differentiated by its < 1 cm thick rhizomes with elongate internodes to at least 8 cm (vs. rhizomes 1–3 cm thick, with internodes only reaching 2.5 cm long) and its straight (vs. sinuous) leaf lobes. The third specimen *(Quezada 1819*) was previously identified as *B. acutiloba *Liebm., a poorly known species endemic to Oaxaca State, Mexico (Burt-Utley, 2015).In the key to the begonias of Mesoamericana provided by Burt-Utley (2015), *Begonia multiloba *keys out as *B. mcphersonii *Burt-Utley & Utley in couplet 85 of key 5. This species is endemic to Panama and can be distinguished from *B. multiloba *by its persistent (vs. early deciduous) stipules, its longer leaf lobes (the largest to one third or one half the length of the leaf, versus to one fourth of the length of the leaf), and its densely villous (vs. tomentose to densely tomentose) petioles.

description: *Begonia multiloba* is known from three collections, all made within 5 km of each other and outside protected areas. The species’ known range is part of a 15-km ridge reaching ca. 1400 m in elevation and running from the northwest to the southeast. While this ridge is mostly forested, very little natural vegetation remains around the base of the ridge. Google Earth imagery (Google Earth Pro 2020, accessed January 2022) also shows many clear-cut areas, mostly around 1 ha in area, on the main ridge. These areas were mostly felled from 2014 onward, and all known collection localities for B. multiloba are within 500 m of a clear-cut area. All of the localities are considered to represent one location with respect to the threat of clear-cutting. Given the species’ small known range (AOO = 12 km2 , EOO = 12 km2 ; Hughes et al., 2015+) and the continued deforestation within its range, we assess *B. multiloba *as Critically Endangered [CR B1ab(iii)+B2ab(iii)] under IUCN criteria (IUCN, 2022). We note that a full survey of this species across its known and likely range is required to better understand its conservation status.

description: This new species is mostly similar to *B. fimbristipula* Hance in similar plant size, leaf shape, leaf hairs, and morphology of flowers and fruits, but differs mainly in its thickly unillamelate (vs. thinly bilamellate) placentae of the ovary, later (Jun.–Oct. vs. Apr.–Jun.) flowering time, and smaller flower size (5–11 × 5–10 mm vs. 8–15 × 8–12 mm outer tepals of staminate flower). *Begonia ruchengensis *belongs to *B. *sect. *Reichenheimia *based on its tuberous habit and unilamellate placentae of ovary. description: Critically Endangered (CR) (B1B2b(i to v)c(ii,iv)). Although the new species has nearly several thousands of individuals distributed in about 20 minor populations, it is restrictedly distributed in a very small area (extent of occurrence < 80 km2, area of occupancy < 10 km2) of Jiulongjiang Forest Park of Rucheng county of Hunan. Therefore, it should be considered as one population without geographical isolation. The habitat of the new species is very unique and fragile (only growing on mossy rock surface or rock crevices in shady or half shady places), and accordingly the population size is easily influenced by climate change, especially by draught (IUCN, 2022).

description: The new species is mostly similar to *B. villifolia* Irmsch. in hairy leaves, flowers and fruits, but is easily differentiated by its 3 (vs. 2) incomplete-locular ovary, concaved (vs. flat) abaxial wing, shorter (to 60 vs. to 100 cm) plant, usually multicolored (vs. pure green) leaf, early (Feb. to Mar. vs. May to Jul.) flowering time. It is also morphologically close to *B. khaophanomensis* Phutthai & M.Hughes (Phutthai and Hughes, 2016) native to Thailand in the same section, but differs mainly by the latter’s leaf lobed (vs. unlobed), and abaxial wing larger (4 cm vs. ca. 1 cm long), and wing shape (oblong or obliquely triangular vs. auricular).This species usually has two styles and stigmas but three-locular ovary in which two locules are normally developed and the third one is degenerated. It should be placed in *B. *sect. *Platycentrum *based on the overall morphology. The new species could be an ideal material for studying the evolution of three locules to two locules of ovary in *Begonia*.

description: Herb evergreen, 30–60 cm tall; rhizome creeping or nearly so, 1–4 cm long, 3–10 mm thick; aerial stems erect or suberect, green, few branched, internodes 1–11 cm long, 5–12 mm thick, densely white or pink pilose, hairs 5–7 mm long, nodes slightly dilated. Stipule persistent, pale green, papery, obliquely triangular, 7–12 × 5–8 mm, abaxially covered with densely whitish pilosity less than 3 mm long; margin hairy; apex acuminate, abaxially ridged; arista 5–7 mm long, densely fimbriate; hairs to 4 mm long. Leaves: 4–10; petiole green, 4–22 cm long, 2–5 mm thick, adaxially grooved, unspotted, densely greyish-white or pink villous, 6 mm long; blade obliquely ovate, 7–27 × 4–17 cm; adaxial surface densely pink or greyish-white and base-enlarged pilose, interveinal area light green, veinal area dark green; abaxial surface green and purplish red, densely red or greyish-white pilose, hairs 1–3 mm long and longer on main veins; venation palmate–pinnate, veins 6 (7), adaxially impressed, abaxially raised; apex acuminate to short caudate; margins serrate and ciliate, occasionally coarsely toothed; base obliquely cordate; acutely angled to nearly overlapped. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, 6–12 cm long, peduncle hairy, 4.5–7 cm long, 2.5–3.5 mm thick; flowers 5–7, rarely 3 per inflorescence. Bract persistent, acutely triangular, light green, papery when dried, 10–12 × 4–6 mm; bracteoles 4–10 × 2–6 mm, covered with greyish-white pilosity (3 mm long), margin ciliate, apex often acuminate. Staminate flower: 4.7–5.3 × 3.7–4.2 cm; tepals 4; outer 2, large, white, ovate to cordate, 2.4–2.9 × 2.4–3 cm, center thicker and adaxially slightly concave, bilateral bases decurrent ca. 5 mm, apex obtuse, longitudinal veins clear; abaxially sparsely greyish-white pilose, hairs ca. 2.5 mm long; inner 2, smaller, white, nearly obovate-lanceolate, 1.7–2 × 1–1.6 cm, margin slightly turnover, central part abaxially sparsely greyish-white pilose, apex obtuse, margin sparsely white ciliate, cilia ca. 1 mm long; androecium nearly capitate, symmetric, 6–8 × 8–10 mm, apically loosely arranged, stamens (67–)84–182; filament ca. 1 mm long, base slightly connate; anther yellow, nearly short cuneate, 0.8–1.5 mm long, up to 1 mm wide, apex clearly retuse; pedicel white, 3.5–4.5 cm long, 2–3 mm thick, densely covered with greyish-white pilosity (ca. 2 mm long). Pistillate flower: occasionally open prior to staminate flower, subsquare or oblong in shape, 4–5 × 34.4 cm; tepals 5, white; outer 4, larger, outside-in gradually smaller, ovate or ovate–cordate, 1.9–2.6 × 1.7– 2.1 cm, apex obtuse or acute; abaxially greyish white pilose, hairs more in middle part, ca. 3 mm long; adaxially longitudinal veins relatively obvious, dark; inner 1, significantly smaller, obovate or obovate-lanceolate, 1.51.8 × 1–1.2 cm, glabrous, apex obtuse or acute; styles + stigmas 4–5 mm long; stigmas 2, rarely 3, well developed, 7 × 5 mm in diameter, U–shaped, twisted nearly 3 turns; ovary white, densely covered with greyish white pilosity (3 mm long), incomplete 3-locular, upper 1 (broadestwinged side) smaller or degenerated; placentation axile, bilamellate; pedicel white, 2–2.1 cm long, 1.2–1.8 mm thick, with greyish white pilosity. Fruit capsule, suborbicular, ca. 10 × 10 mm, unequally 3–winged; abaxial wing large, auricular, concave, ca. 10 × 10 mm; lateral wings smaller, falcate, 2–3 × ca. 10 mm.

description: *Begonia floriprolifera *is morphologically close to *B. bonii *Gapnep. in the same section, but can be mainly distinguished from the latter by its nearly glabrous (vs. pilose) stipules, short shorter inflorescence (2.5–20 cm vs. over 20 cm), bilaterally symmetric and upward curved (vs. radially symmetric and capitate) androecium, fewer (up to 32 vs. usually over 40) stamens, and anther apex (concave vs. rounded) (Table 1, Fig. S2). Moreover, this species showed rich variation in leaf color (adaxially green to brownish red, abaxially light green to deep red), size and color of variegation patches (absent to large), and flower color (white to pink) (Fig. 2 and 3). In addition, this species is also morphologically similar to *B. bamaensis* Yan Liu & C.I Peng and *B. lui* S.M.Ku, C.I Peng & Yan Liu in the same section. However, it differs from *B. bamaensis *by leaf size and color, indumentums of leaf and flower, stamen number and fruit morphology (Liu et al., 2007). It could be also distinguished from *B. lui* in plant size, leaf morphology (blade color, leaf maculations, etc.), morphology of flower and fruit, and flowering time (Liu et al., 2020).

description: Herb monoecious, perennial, rhizomatous, 5–15 cm tall. Rhizome creeping, 5–20 cm or longer, unbranched to few branched, green to pale brown, internodes 5–8 mm long, 3–15 mm thick. Stipules persistent, green to red, nearly glabrous, long triangular, 5–8 mm × 4–7 mm, apex acuminate. Leaves simple, alternate, basal, leaf blade broad ovate, (2.6–)6–12(–24) cm × (1.9–)2.8–12(–17.5) cm, decurrent part 0.2–5.5 cm long, papery, asymmetric, adaxially green to deep brownish red, usually adorned with white to light green radial patches between veins, densely papillose-hispid, abaxially light green to deep red, densely green to red setulose, main veins 5–7, reticulate, margin serrate, base slightly to nearly overlapped, apex acuminate. Petiole green to brownish red, (1.7–)5–12(–22) cm long, 1.5–6 mm thick, ungrooved, densely gray-white villous, hairs 1–5 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, 1–8, dichasial cymes arising from rhizome, 2.5–20 cm long, branched 2–3 times, peduncle light green to reddish brown, cylindrical, 1.5–15 cm long, 1–2.5 mm thick, glabrous to sparsely villous, flowers 3–30 per inflorescence. Bracts persistent or caduceus, ellipsoid to ovate, light green, abaxially pubescent or glabrous, margin sparsely pubescent, lower bracts 2–5 mm × 1–4 mm, upper ones 1–3 mm × 0.4–2.5 mm. Staminate flower pedicel glabrous to sparsely pubescent, 8–35.5 mm long, 0.5–1 mm thick, flower size 16.5–33.5 mm × 13.2–29 mm; tepals 4 (rarely 6), white to pink, entire, outer 2 broad ovate to elliptic, 8.5–16 mm × 7.5–15.8 mm, abaxially sparsely pubescent or glabrous, inner 2 oblong to oblanceolate, glabrous, 6.515 mm × 2.5–9 mm; androecium bilaterally symmetric, upward curved, 1.8–3.5 mm × 2–5 mm, stamens 11–21(32), filaments yellow, 1–3 mm long, anthers yellow, cuneiform, 0.5–2 mm long, 0.5–0.8 mm wide, apex slightly concave. Pistillate flower pedicel glabrous to sparsely pubescent, 5–12.5 mm long, 0.5–0.8 mm thick, flower size 20.5–30 mm × 11–19 mm, tepals 3 (rarely 2 or 4), white to pink, entire, outer 2 elliptic to nearly round, 10–15 mm × 9–15.5 mm, glabrous, inner 1 (rarely 2 or absent), glabrous, oblong to cuneiform, 5–10.5 mm × 25 mm; style 3, yellow, connate base 0.5–1.6 mm long, free part 2.5–3.5 mm long, stigmatic band spiraled. Ovary light green to whitish, sparsely pilose when young, 1locular, placentation parietal, placentae 3, each bifurcate. Fruit nearly glabrous, 8.5–10.5 mm × 6.5–9 mm, 3winged, abaxial wing broad crescent–shaped, 2.7–4.2 mm × 6.7–8.4 mm; lateral wings equal, narrowly crescent–shaped, 2–3 mm × 6.5–8 mm. Seeds numerous, brown, elliptic.

description: Both distribution area and occupied area of the new species are very small, and a very unique habitat either in cave or near the waterfall limits the expansion of its population. Other distribution locations may be found in the future. A relatively large population in the type locality of this species is located in a large cave of Guangxi, China, with a groundwater flow inside. However, recently no groundwater flow has been observed due to an unknown reason. As a result, some plants of this population already died, and the population is gradually shrinking in size. Based on the current data, this species should be categorized as Endangered (EN: B1B2ab (ⅲ, v), C1) (IUCN, 2022).

description: *Begonia matahom *is currently known only from the type locality, with one population and several individuals. The area is not protected under the country’s National Integrated Protected Areas System by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources. The conservation status of the species is hard to assess, Mt. Tingtingan has not been fully botanized due to peace and order situation. Therefore following IUCN red list and criteria (IUCN, 2022), *B. matahom* is hereby proposed as Data Deficient (DD).

description: *Begonia barosma *morphologically resembles *B. lanternaria *in rhizome and flower characters. However, it differs from the latter in having fleshy, relatively flat leaf blade which is adaxially blackish-green along main veins, randomly silver white between the veins, abaxailly purple-red and densely pilose along main veins, pale green between the veins. In addition, the new species also can be distinguished from *B. lanternaria *in sparsely pilose on abaxial surface of outer tepals.

description: Description: perennial evergreen herb, monoecious, 20–35 cm tall. Rhizome stout and creeping, 10–15 cm long and 15–25 mm in diameter, internodes obvious and crowded. Stipules reddish-brown, ovate-triangular, 8–13 × 9–15 mm, pilose. Leaves all basal, petiole reddishbrown, 8–12 cm long, densely pilose with pale green lenticles; blade asymmetric, widely ovate, 19–20 × 12–14 cm; apex caudate, base oblique-cordate; margin subentire; venation palmate with 6–9 primary veins, adaxially slightly concave, abaxially convex; leaf blade fleshy and relatively flat, adaxially blackish-green along main veins, randomly silver white between the veins, sparsely puberulous, abaxially purplish-red and densely pilose along main veins, pale green and subgrabrous between the veins. Inflorescences arising directly from rhizome; dichasial cymes branching two or three times, peduncle 13–18 cm long, glabrous; flowers unisexual, 10–12 flowers per inflorescence; bracts membranous, widely ovate to subcircular, pinkish-yellow, 4–10 × 3–8 mm, margin puberulous. Staminate flower: pedicels pale green, 20–23 mm long, glabrous; tepals 4, outer 2 whitish-pink, widely ovate to circular, margin entire, 2023 × 16–26 mm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially redly pilose; inner 2 pinkish-white, lanceolate, margin entire, 15–18 × 7–8 mm, glabrous; androecium zygomorphic, 5.6 × 7.5 mm; stamens numerous, 5.0 mm long, filaments fused at base, anthers golden yellow, clavate, base cuneate, apex retuse. Pistillate flower: pedicels pink, 1320 mm long, glabrous; tepals 3, whitish-pink, outer 2 widely ovate to subcircular, margin entire, 16–18 × 1516 mm, adaxially glabrous, abaxially sparsely pilose or glabrous; inner 1 obovate, 10–12 × 5–6 mm, glabrous; ovary pink, trigonous-ellipsoid, 11–18 × 4.6–8 mm (wings excluded), sparsely redly pilose; 1-lobuled, placentation parietal; placentae 3, each 2-branched; styles 3, fused at base, golden yellow, 3.8–5 mm long, stigma spirally U-shaped twisted. Capsule nodding, trigonousellipsoid, 18–20 × 5–6 mm (wings excluded), pinkishgreen, glabrous, unequally 3-winged, lateral wings 2, crescent-shaped, 14–16 × 2–3 mm, abaxial wing semilune-shaped, 18–20 × 7–9 mm.

description: Similar to *Begonia anisoptera* in having obliquely ovate to widely ovate leaves, 4-tepaled staminate and pis-tillate flowers and three winged capsules. However, the new species can be easily distinguished in having stip-ules glabrescent (vs. densely hirsute), petioles 16.5–28.0 cm long, indumentum reddish-maroon, appressed (vs. 4–12 cm long, hairs brown and spreading), larger leaves 8–17 × 7.0–11.5 cm, distantly serrate (vs. 6–12 × 4–8 cm, entire), inflorescence cymosely branching 5–7 times (vs. 2–3 times), oblanceolate inner staminate and pistillate tepals (vs. obovate to cuneiform) with rounded apex (vs. truncate to slightly retuse), capsule recurved or pendu-lous (vs. splash cup), wings subequal and flat (vs. strong-ly unequal, abaxial wing cucullate, lateral wings curved).
